about_zh: 路线图、教程、书籍、算法与科研。

repos.description: Master programming by recreating your favorite technologies from scratch.
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供从零构建各类技术的分步指南，涵盖操作系统、数据库、神经网络、3D渲染等20+领域。通过实践深入理解计算机底层原理与系统设计，支持C++、Python、Java等多种语言。适合开发者通过动手实践掌握核心技术，践行'不创造即不理解'的学习理念，是进阶编程能力的绝佳资源。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers comprehensive step-by-step guides for building various technologies from scratch, covering 20+ domains including operating systems, databases, neural networks, 3D renderers, blockchain, and augmented reality. It enables developers to deeply understand computer fundamentals and system design through hands-on implementation and practical coding exercises. The tutorials support multiple programming languages like C++, Python, Java, and JavaScript, accommodating different skill sets. Embodying Richard Feynman's philosophy 'What I cannot create, I do not understand', it serves as an exceptional educational resource for advancing programming expertise by recreating core technologies from first principles, making it ideal for intermediate to advanced developers seeking true mastery of computing systems.

repos.description: :books: 技术面试必备基础知识、Leetcode、计算机操作系统、计算机网络、系统设计
repos.summary_zh: CS-Notes 是专为技术面试打造的全栈知识体系，系统整合算法（LeetCode、剑指Offer 题解）、操作系统、计算机网络、数据库原理、Java 核心技术（并发、JVM）及大规模系统设计等核心内容。以实战为导向，深度结合理论与实践，覆盖从基础到架构的完整技能树，是程序员求职面试的高效复习指南。
repos.summary_en: CS-Notes is a systematic knowledge repository specifically designed for technical interview preparation, encompassing core CS fundamentals including algorithms (LeetCode, 剑指Offer solutions), operating systems, computer networks, database principles, Java internals (concurrency, JVM, I/O), and large-scale system design. It bridges theory with hands-on practice through extensive coding problems and architectural case studies, offering a complete skill development path from basic concepts to advanced engineering architecture for software engineers.

repos.description: 《Hello 算法》：动画图解、一键运行的数据结构与算法教程。支持简中、繁中、English、日本語，提供 Python, Java, C++, C, C#, JS, Go, Swift, Rust, Ruby, Kotlin, TS, Dart 等代码实现
repos.summary_zh: 《Hello 算法》是一本开源免费的数据结构与算法教程，采用动画图解显著降低学习门槛，支持12+编程语言一键运行代码。覆盖简中、繁中、英文、日文，适合编程新手与面试准备者，通过可视化与实操结合高效提升算法思维与工程实现能力。
repos.summary_en: Hello Algo is a free open-source tutorial that demystifies data structures and algorithms through animated visualizations and interactive code execution. Supporting 12+ programming languages and four human languages, it offers smooth learning curves with visual explanations and hands-on practice. Ideal for beginners and interview candidates, it effectively bridges theory with implementation to build algorithmic thinking.

repos.description: Course to get into Large Language Models (LLMs) with roadmaps and Colab notebooks.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个免费的LLM系统学习课程，提供从数学基础到工程实践的完整路线图。课程分为三部分：LLM基础、LLM科学家（模型构建与优化）和LLM工程师（应用开发与部署）。包含大量实用的Google Colab notebooks，涵盖模型微调、合并、量化、评估等实战技术，并配套自动化工具，适合想深入LLM领域的开发者。
repos.summary_en: This is a free, comprehensive LLM course offering structured learning paths from mathematical foundations to production deployment. The curriculum is divided into three parts: LLM Fundamentals, The LLM Scientist (focusing on building optimal models with cutting-edge techniques), and The LLM Engineer (covering application development and deployment). It provides extensive Google Colab notebooks for hands-on practice, including tools for fine-tuning, model merging, quantization, and automated evaluation. Based on the LLM Engineer's Handbook, it's designed for developers seeking practical LLM expertise.

repos.description: 健康学习到150岁 - 人体系统调优不完全指南
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库基于斯坦福神经科学教授Andrew Huberman的同行评审研究，提供一套系统化的人体系统优化方案。核心是通过调控生物钟、间歇性禁食、科学运动和营养补充等零成本干预手段，像调优软件一样优化睡眠、代谢和认知功能。内容涵盖光疗调节昼夜节律、禁食机制促进细胞自噬、精准运动时机选择等实证方法，旨在实现健康寿命延长和工作学习表现提升。
repos.summary_en: This repository presents a systematic human system optimization framework based on peer-reviewed neuroscience research from Stanford Professor Andrew Huberman. It provides evidence-based, zero-cost interventions to optimize sleep, metabolism, and cognitive performance by treating the human body as a tunable system. Key methodologies include circadian rhythm regulation through light exposure, intermittent fasting for cellular autophagy, precision exercise timing, and targeted nutrition. The guide aims to extend healthspan and enhance daily performance through scientifically-validated practices rather than commercialized wellness trends.

repos.description: Practice your rust skill hardly
repos.summary_zh: Rust By Practice是专为Rust学习者设计的在线交互式练习手册，通过大量从易到难的示例、练习与实践项目，覆盖异步、并发、标准库、数据结构和算法等全方面知识。每题均可在线编辑运行并提供完整解答，旨在填补理论学习与真实项目落地之间的鸿沟，帮助快速上手Rust实战。
repos.summary_en: Rust By Practice is an interactive online exercise book designed for Rust learners. It offers extensive examples, challenges and projects covering async/await, concurrency, standard libraries, data structures and algorithms. Exercises can be edited and run online with full solutions, bridging the gap between learning and real-world project readiness with progressive difficulty levels.

repos.description: Free Motion Capture for Everyone 💀✨
repos.summary_zh: FreeMoCap是开源无标记动作捕捉系统，使用普通摄像头实现研究级3D人体运动重建。硬件无关、低成本，支持多机位同步标定、姿态估计与三角化，输出Blender/CSV等格式，面向科研、教育、生物力学与动画。
repos.summary_en: FreeMoCap is a free open-source markerless motion capture system delivering research-grade 3D human movement tracking from ordinary webcams. Hardware-agnostic and low-cost, it supports multi-camera sync, calibration, pose estimation and triangulation, with Blender/CSV exports for research, education, biomechanics and animation.

repos.description: Become a cracked AI/ML researcher/engineer with this unconventional textbook covering maths, computing, and ML with intuition.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个面向AI/ML研究工程师的系统性学习资料库，涵盖数学基础、计算机科学和人工智能核心领域。内容强调直觉理解而非公式堆砌，从向量、矩阵、概率论等基础到Transformer、多模态学习、GPU编程等前沿技术。基于作者帮助多人成功入职DeepMind、OpenAI等顶级公司的实战经验，提供从理论到工程实践的一站式知识体系，适合面试准备和深度技术学习。
repos.summary_en: This is a systematic learning compendium for AI/ML Research Engineers, covering mathematics fundamentals, computer science, and core AI domains. Emphasizing intuitive understanding over dense notation, it spans from vectors, matrices, probability to cutting-edge topics like Transformers, multimodal learning, and GPU programming. Based on proven success in preparing candidates for top AI companies like DeepMind and OpenAI, it offers a comprehensive knowledge bridge from theory to engineering practice.

repos.description: A contact solver for physics-based simulations involving 👚 shells, 🪵 solids, 🪢 rods, 🧱 rigid bodies and ⏳ sand.
repos.summary_zh: ZOZO开源的高性能GPU接触求解器，专为布料、固体和绳索的物理仿真设计。采用FEM有限元方法与符号力雅可比，支持超1.8亿接触点的大规模并行计算，实现无穿透的精确模拟。提供Blender插件、Docker部署和Python API，适用于时尚电商、游戏特效等场景，单精度GPU加速确保高效稳定。
repos.summary_en: ZOZO's high-performance GPU contact solver for physics simulation of shells, solids and rods. Leveraging FEM with symbolic force jacobians, it handles over 180M contacts in parallel with penetration-free accuracy. Features Blender integration, Docker deployment and Python APIs, ideal for fashion e-commerce and visual effects. Single-precision GPU acceleration ensures efficiency.

repos.description: List of Science courses with video lectures
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库聚合了MIT、斯坦福、耶鲁等顶尖学府的数学与科学视频课程资源，涵盖物理、量子力学、弦理论等前沿领域。核心价值在于提供免费、高质量的系统化学习材料，适合自学深造和教学参考。技术亮点是资源整合与分类，便于用户快速定位所需课程。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates a comprehensive collection of free video lectures from prestigious institutions including MIT, Stanford, and Yale, spanning mathematics, physics, quantum mechanics, string theory, and cosmology. It offers systematically organized, high-quality educational resources for self-paced learning and academic reference. The key technical value lies in its meticulous categorization and direct access to otherwise hard-to-find advanced course materials from world-renowned professors.

repos.description: Introduction to Autonomous Robots
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供MIT出版社《自主机器人导论：机制、传感器、执行器与算法》教材的LaTeX源代码。该书聚焦自主机器人计算原理，涵盖机制、传感器、执行器和算法。采用CC-BY-NC-ND许可，允许非商业教学用途并需署名。可通过LaTeX或Overleaf编译PDF，印刷版见亚马逊。是机器人教育与研究的重要资源。
repos.summary_en: The repository provides the LaTeX source for the MIT Press textbook 'Introduction to Autonomous Robots: Mechanisms, Sensors, Actuators, and Algorithms'. It focuses on the computational principles of autonomous robots, covering mechanisms, sensors, actuators, and algorithms. Licensed under CC-BY-NC-ND for non-commercial use like teaching with attribution. Users can compile the PDF via LaTeX or Overleaf; print edition available on Amazon. An essential resource for robotics education and research.

repos.description: :earth_americas: machine learning tutorials (mainly in Python3)
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库是系统性的机器学习教程集合，以Jupyter Notebook形式提供。内容涵盖深度学习、强化学习、时间序列等多个领域，核心特色在于平衡数学原理与工程实践：既包含NumPy/SciPy等科学计算栈的从零实现，也演示TensorFlow、PyTorch、scikit-learn等主流框架的工业级应用。适合希望深入理解算法底层并掌握实际部署技能的学习者。
repos.summary_en: This repository is a comprehensive collection of machine learning tutorials in Jupyter Notebook format. It covers diverse topics including deep learning, reinforcement learning, time series analysis, and recommendation systems. The key feature is balancing mathematical theory with hands-on implementation—both from scratch using Python's scientific stack (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, PySpark) and with popular frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and Hugging Face. It serves as an educational resource for learners seeking deep algorithmic understanding alongside practical engineering skills in model deployment and A/B testing.

repos.description: 零知识证明入门教程。Comprehensive Zero-Knowledge Proofs Tutorial. #zk #WIP
repos.summary_zh: WTF-zk 为零知识证明入门教程，面向高中数学基础学习者。项目以 Python 实现核心算法，系统涵盖数论、抽象代数、椭圆曲线等数学基础，并逐步深入 ZK 证明理论。通过 Jupyter Notebook 交互式教学，结合经典密码学方案复现，为零知识证明领域提供低门槛、理论与实践结合的学习路径。
repos.summary_en: WTF-zk is a comprehensive Zero-Knowledge Proofs tutorial designed for learners with only high school mathematics background. The project uses Python to implement core cryptographic algorithms, systematically covering essential mathematical foundations including number theory, abstract algebra, ring fields, and elliptic curves. Through interactive Jupyter Notebook demonstrations and step-by-step reproduction of classic schemes like RSA and Diffie-Hellman, it creates an accessible, theory-practice integrated learning pathway into the ZK proofs domain.

repos.description: ML algorithms implemented and derived from first-principles in Jupyter Notebooks and NumPy
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过 Jupyter Book 和 Marimo 构建交互式机器学习可视化平台，核心价值在于从第一性原理出发，使用 NumPy 纯 Python 实现神经网络、逻辑回归、PCA 等核心算法并配套数学推导。动态可视化训练过程，直观展示权重变化对损失函数的影响，是理解算法内部机制的顶级教学工具。
repos.summary_en: This project builds an interactive ML visualization platform using Jupyter Book and Marimo. It implements core algorithms—neural networks, logistic regression, PCA, etc.—from first principles with NumPy, accompanied by mathematical derivations. Dynamic visualizations show training progression and weight-loss relationships, serving as a premier educational tool for understanding algorithmic internals.

repos.description: AetherViz Master - 互动教育可视化建筑师，将任意教学主题转化为沉浸式3D交互网页
repos.summary_zh: AetherViz Master 是一款 AI 驱动的互动教育可视化工具，能将任意教学主题一键转化为沉浸式 3D 交互网页。支持物理、化学、生物、数学等多学科，自动识别领域并匹配最佳渲染方案。核心价值在于零代码生成专业教学页面，集成 Three.js 3D 引擎、SVG 混合渲染、KaTeX 公式及 OrbitControls 交互。适用于教师、学生和内容创作者，通过 Claude 等 AI 助手实现快速沉浸式学习内容创作，提供粒子系统、测验面板和响应式玻璃拟态 UI。
repos.summary_en: AetherViz Master is an AI-powered interactive educational visualization tool that instantly converts any teaching topic into immersive 3D interactive web pages. It supports subjects like physics, chemistry, biology, and math with automatic domain recognition and optimal rendering selection. Core value lies in zero-code generation of professional teaching pages using Three.js 3D engine, hybrid SVG rendering, KaTeX formulas, and OrbitControls. Ideal for teachers, students, and creators, it integrates with AI assistants like Claude for rapid immersive content creation, featuring particle systems, quizzes, and responsive glassmorphism UI.

repos.description: A comprehensive book on neural networks and large language models in NLP
repos.summary_zh: NiuTrans/NLPBook仓库发布《Natural Language Processing: Neural Networks and Large Language Models》一书，由童晓、朱靖波撰写。系统覆盖机器学习与神经网络基础、词向量、RNN/CNN、Seq2Seq、Transformer，以及大模型的预训练、生成、提示工程、对齐与推理等前沿内容。提供各章节及完整免费PDF下载，基于arXiv论文扩展，适合NLP研究者、学生和开发者学习使用，并有中、日、法等多语言翻译版本。
repos.summary_en: The NiuTrans/NLPBook repository presents the book 'Natural Language Processing: Neural Networks and Large Language Models' by Tong Xiao and Jingbo Zhu. It comprehensively covers ML and neural network foundations, word vectors, RNN/CNN, Seq2Seq, Transformers, plus LLM topics including pre-training, generative models, prompting, alignment, and inference. Free PDF chapters and full book are available, expanded from arXiv papers. Ideal educational resource for NLP researchers, students, and practitioners, with translations into multiple languages.

repos.description: Open-source High-Level System Design, DSA, and AI Engineering handbooks. CC BY-SA 4.0, Free Forever.
repos.summary_zh: handbook-academy/engineering-handbook 是开源工程手册仓库，包含两本CC BY-SA 4.0免费手册。HLD手册159章、719 Mermaid图、3100+引用，系统覆盖高阶系统设计、分布式系统与基础设施（从TCP/IP到LLM服务）；DSA手册120章、226图、多语言LeetCode解法，专注数据结构算法与面试实践。内容规模相当于数千页教科书，提供系统化深度学习与职业准备资源。
repos.summary_en: The handbook-academy/engineering-handbook repository hosts two sibling open-source engineering handbooks under CC BY-SA 4.0. The HLD Handbook delivers 159 chapters on high-level system design, distributed systems, and modern infrastructure with 719 Mermaid diagrams and 3,100+ citations. The DSA Handbook covers 120 chapters of data structures and algorithms, including multi-language LeetCode solutions and interactive widgets. Together they provide massive, free curricula equivalent to thousands of pages for deep engineering learning and interview preparation.

repos.description: For Investing for Programmers book published by Manning
repos.summary_zh: 本书专为程序员编写，系统讲解如何利用编程技能进行量化投资与算法交易。内容涵盖金融数据分析、交易策略开发、回测系统构建等实战主题，使用Python等工具将编程思维应用于投资决策。适合希望将技术优势转化为投资能力的开发者，提供可复用的代码示例与项目实践。
repos.summary_en: Specifically designed for programmers, this book systematically explains how to leverage coding skills for quantitative investing and algorithmic trading. It covers practical topics including financial data analysis, trading strategy development, and backtesting system construction, using tools like Python to apply programming thinking to investment decisions. Suitable for developers who want to transform their technical advantages into investment capabilities, it provides reusable code examples and project practices.

repos.description: 🐸 Read Frog | Open Source Immersive Translate - unofficial userscript port / 🐸 陪读蛙 | 开源沉浸式翻译 - 非官方油猴脚本
repos.summary_zh: rong6/read-frog 是 Read Frog 项目的非官方用户脚本移植仓库，将浏览器扩展适配为 Tampermonkey/Violentmonkey 脚本，支持移动浏览器运行。核心功能包括 AI 驱动的沉浸式翻译、文章分析及多模型支持，助力浏览器语言学习。技术亮点在于保留上游代码，仅替换平台实现，兼容移动端。适用于网页阅读翻译和深度语言掌握，尤其适合扩展不可用的移动场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides an unofficial userscript port of the Read Frog AI-powered language learning browser extension. It adapts the original extension for Tampermonkey and Violentmonkey userscripts, enabling use on mobile browsers where extensions are not supported. Features include immersive translation, article analysis, and compatibility with multiple AI models. The port keeps the core application logic intact while replacing extension platform components. It serves language learners by facilitating seamless web content translation and analysis directly in the browser, with particular value for mobile users.

repos.description: Knowledge layer for building language-learning apps: knowledge points for English, Japanese and Chinese, pedagogical primitives, building blocks and a blueprint planner. CC BY-NC 4.0.
repos.summary_zh: OpenLanguageKit为语言学习应用提供标准化知识层，覆盖英日中三语，含950个知识点、56种练习类型、96个现成页面及14条课程轨道。纯JSON/HTML/JS无依赖，可被教师、开发者或AI直接复用，解决“教什么、按何顺序、如何练”的核心难题。
repos.summary_en: OpenLanguageKit provides a standardized knowledge layer for language-learning apps, covering English, Japanese, and Chinese with 950 knowledge points, 56 practice types, 96 ready-made pages, and 14 course tracks. Built as dependency-free JSON/HTML/JS, it enables teachers, developers, or coding AIs to reuse content and solve the core challenge of what to teach, in what order, and how to practice.
